name: UMAMUSUME | Tokyo Racecourse [Mobile Support]
desc:
Legacy version. The revamped version can be found here:
https://www.roblox.com/games/94501457356972/UMADACCHI

Press R to activate Umamusume running mode. Press again to switch to normal mode.

You can select an Umamusume character by pressing the G key.
You can switch to camera mode by pressing the C key. Pressing it again will return to normal mode. In camera mode, if you hold down the C key for more than 2 seconds, the player selection screen will disappear.
